facts.fact: The Société nationale de développement informatique (SNDI) trained 203 state officials in Agnéby-Tiassa in IT tools from 17 June to 23 July 2025, and its director general said more than 31,000 officials nationally have had this training.
facts.system: SNDI IT tools training for state officials

CIV.note: The training is said to reduce the digital divide in skills; no rural internet programme is stated.
SNDI is named only as a trainer of officials; no systems it runs for government are stated.
